answer_1.quote: We utilize the English subsets from OpenAudioBench , including AlpacaEval , LLaMA Questions , TriviaQA , and Web Questions . For the evaluation process, we employ Qwen-max to score and determine the correctness of responses.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates both speech and text responses simultaneously.

answer_2.quote: To assess the alignment between speech and text responses, we transcribe the speech by Whisper-large-v3  and compute the word error rate (WER) between the transcription and the corresponding text response.
